```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

var_names <- c(
  "record_id",
  "name",
  "Participants",
  "Cohort",
  "stage",
  "com_discipline",
  "region",
  "Role",
  "Title",
  "Abstract",
  "Award Type",
  "Amount",
  "Start Date",
  "End Date",
  "agency",
  "mhealth_classification"
)
```



```{r, include=FALSE}
data <- read_excel("data_merged_classified.xlsx", sheet = 1)[,var_names]


data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    `Award Category` = case_when(
      `Award Type` %in% c(
        "R01", "R03", "R21", "R34", "R37", "R56", "RF1"
      ) ~ "Research Projects",

      `Award Type` %in% c(
        "U01", "R61", "R33", "UG3", "R18"
      ) ~ "Cooperative / Multi-component Research",

      `Award Type` %in% c(
        "K01", "K08", "K23", "K24", "R00"
      ) ~ "Career Development & Transition",

      `Award Type` %in% c(
        "T32", "F30", "D43"
      ) ~ "Training & Fellowships",

      `Award Type` %in% c(
        "P30", "P50", "U48", "UM1"
      ) ~ "Centers & Large Research Programs",

      `Award Type` %in% c(
        "R41", "R42", "R43", "R44"
      ) ~ "Small Business Research",

      `Award Type` %in% c(
        "R13", "R25"
      ) ~ "Conferences & Research Education",

      TRUE ~ "Other / Review"
    )
  )
```

## Overall

```{r, echo=FALSE}
data |> 
  reframe(Amount = sum(Amount),
          Counts = n()) |> 
  gt()
```


## Funding Agency

```{r, echo=FALSE}
data |> 
  group_by(agency) |> 
  reframe(Amount = sum(Amount),
          Counts = n()) |> 
  gt()
```


## Funding Agency

```{r, echo=FALSE}
data |> 
  group_by(`Award Category`) |> 
  reframe(Amount = sum(Amount),
          Counts = n()) |> 
  gt()
```
